analysis.visual_description: On the board. A single leaf on the desk. The date is written. The rest of the page is blank. The pen lies beside it, not in a hand.
On the board. The same leaf, lower down. No line, no strike, no sum. The candle is unlit. The blank is the whole of the lower page.
On the board. The book of the comedy shut at the edge of the desk. The blank leaf is the page in front. Daylight, and no one in the frame. Nothing else has been written.
